hero.subtitle: Explore opportunities to work with us, build real-world experience, and help sellers grow their businesses online.

internship.title: Stallio Summer Internship Program
internship.description: Spend your summer working closely with the Stallio team on real projects in product, marketing, and operations. Ideal for students who want startup experience and a portfolio they can show employers.
highlights: Work on live product and growth initiatives
Weekly mentorship from the founding team
Certificate and reference letter for strong performers
Priority consideration for future roles at Stallio

ambassador.title: Stallio Campus Ambassador Program
ambassador.description: Represent Stallio at your university. Help small businesses and social sellers discover Stallio while building marketing, content, and outreach skills on your campus.
highlights: Create at least one short-form video per month
Reach potential sellers through your network
Promote Stallio in student and seller communities
Official ambassador title, certificate, and ambassador kit
Direct mentorship and networking with other ambassadors
